page: Microsoft Azure L96aos_v5 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 96 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture. The system is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A primary characteristic of this server type is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 69,115 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. The instance does not include any integrated graphics processing units, making it reliant entirely on the 96 dedicated AMD vCPUs for all computational tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the L96aos_v5 offers high resource density by combining substantial memory capacity with an exceptionally large local NVMe SSD footprint on a single instance. This configuration reduces the need for external storage attachments, though the lack of GPU acceleration limits its utility for deep learning workloads.

This server configuration is designed for data-intensive workloads that require large-scale local storage and substantial memory. Suitable use cases include large relational and non-relational databases, big data analytics, data warehousing, and enterprise applications requiring high-speed local scratch space.
